seoTitle: Cobra Kai Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Cobra Kai test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Johnny, Daniel, Miguel, Robby, Sam, Tory, Hawk, Demetri or Kreese — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the old-school sensei, the principled rival, or the kid who reinvented himself overnight? Answer 12 everyday questions about rivals, comebacks and doing the right thing, and find out which Cobra Kai character you are.

characters.name: Johnny Lawrence
characters.title: The Comeback Kid
characters.summary: Blunt, old-school and tougher than you look. You do things your own way, and underneath it all you've got a huge heart.
description: Like Johnny, you do things your own way. He was Cobra Kai's top student as a teenager, and he's the one who brings the dojo back.
You can change. After quitting Cobra Kai, Johnny opens his own dojo, Eagle Fang Karate.
You end up with the family you always wanted. In season 6, Johnny marries Carmen.
characters.flaw: You act first and think later, and you hate admitting you're wrong.
characters.signature: Loud rock music, a tough-love speech and a heart of gold underneath.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you to toughen up, then insist they were helping

characters.name: Daniel LaRusso
characters.title: The Principled One
characters.summary: Principled, devoted and sure of what's right. You live by what you were taught, even if you can be a little smug about it.
description: Like Daniel, you live by your principles. He learned karate from Mr. Miyagi to defend himself from bullies, and he runs Miyagi-Do.
You've built a good life. Daniel runs LaRusso Auto with his wife, Amanda.
You make peace in the end. In season 6, Daniel and Johnny reform Cobra Kai together.
characters.flaw: You're sure you're right, and you can be a little smug about it.
characters.signature: A calm breath, a family photo and a lesson from your old teacher.
characters.clashReason: they'd lecture you about balance while doing the exact opposite

characters.name: Miguel Diaz
characters.title: The Good Fighter
characters.summary: Brave, loyal and kind. You'd fight for anyone you care about, and you always try to do the right thing.
description: Like Miguel, you're brave and loyal. He's the very first student at Johnny's Cobra Kai dojo.
You come back stronger. Miguel wins the 50th All Valley tournament, and later fights his way back from a serious injury.
You go far. Miguel wins the Sekai Taikai, and heads off to Stanford.
characters.flaw: You're so torn between being good and being strong that you second-guess yourself.
characters.signature: A big smile, a strong stance and a friend you'd fight for.
characters.clashReason: they'd forgive people you think don't deserve it

characters.name: Robby Keene
characters.title: The Lone Wolf
characters.summary: Talented, independent and guarded. You've learned to look after yourself, and you don't let people in easily.
description: Like Robby, you've had to look after yourself. He's Johnny's estranged teenage son.
You're still working out where you belong. Robby goes from Miyagi-Do to Cobra Kai, then back to Miyagi-Do.
You find your way in the end. Robby and Tory accept a job promoting karate together.
characters.flaw: You keep people at arm's length, so they can't let you down.
characters.signature: A guarded look, a chip on your shoulder and more talent than you let on.
characters.clashReason: they'd shut you out the moment you got close

characters.name: Sam LaRusso
characters.title: The Captain
characters.summary: Skilled, confident and very stubborn. You lead from the front, and you don't back down once you've made up your mind.
description: Like Sam, you're skilled and stubborn. She's Daniel's daughter, and he taught her karate when she was young.
You lead from the front. In season 6, Sam becomes Miyagi-Do's female captain.
You're ready for the next adventure. At the end of the series, Sam leaves for a student programme in Okinawa.
characters.flaw: You're too stubborn to admit when someone else has a point.
characters.signature: Perfect form, a determined look and something to prove.
characters.clashReason: they'd refuse to back down, even when they were clearly wrong

characters.name: Tory Nichols
characters.title: The Queen
characters.summary: Fierce, hard-working and fiercely guarded. You've had to fight for everything, and you never give up.
description: Like Tory, you're a fighter. She comes from a poor family, joins Cobra Kai and becomes its top female fighter.
You earn your titles. Tory is known as "Queen Cobra."
You come out on top. Tory wins the Sekai Taikai, and becomes a karate influencer and competitor.
characters.flaw: You don't trust anyone until they've proven themselves, twice.
characters.signature: A fierce glare, a hard day's work and a fight you won't lose.
characters.clashReason: they'd see you as competition, and act like it

characters.name: Hawk
characters.title: The Reinvention
characters.summary: Bold, confident and impossible to ignore. You turned yourself into someone new, and you're not going back.
description: Like Hawk, you know how to reinvent yourself. Eli is bullied for a scar on his lip, until he joins Cobra Kai.
You make an entrance. After Johnny tells him to "flip the script," Eli gets a blue mohawk and a huge hawk tattoo on his back.
You come back to your friends. Hawk switches to Miyagi-Do, and wins the boys' division of the 51st All Valley tournament.
characters.flaw: You go so far to prove a point that you forget who you used to be.
characters.signature: A blue mohawk, a loud entrance and zero fear.
characters.clashReason: they'd show off at your expense

characters.name: Demetri
characters.title: The Brains
characters.summary: Smart, sarcastic and a little awkward. You'd rather talk your way out of a fight, but you show up when it counts.
description: Like Demetri, you're smart and a little awkward. He's an intelligent, nerdy outsider, and Hawk's best friend.
You take your time. Demetri is very hesitant about karate, but he eventually joins Miyagi-Do.
You go further than anyone expected. Demetri makes the top four at the 51st All Valley tournament.
characters.flaw: You'd rather make a joke than face a fight.
characters.signature: A sarcastic remark, a clever plan and a good excuse to stay out of it.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a sarcastic comment about everything you do

characters.name: John Kreese
characters.title: The Hardliner
characters.summary: Disciplined, tough and relentless. You believe only the strong survive, and you never show weakness.
description: Like Kreese, you believe only the strong survive. He's a Vietnam War Special Forces veteran, and a co-founder of Cobra Kai.
You don't stay down for long. Kreese loses control of the dojo and ends up in prison, then opens a new dojo in South Korea.
You go out on your own terms. In the finale, Kreese sacrifices himself to stop Terry Silver from kidnapping Johnny's family.
characters.flaw: You'd rather win than be decent.
characters.signature: A cold stare, a hard lesson and no mercy at all.
characters.clashReason: they'd see your kindness as weakness, and use it against you

questions.text: Someone cuts in front of you in a long line. You...

options.text: Cut right back in front of them
Calmly point out the line, and expect them to do the right thing
Make a sarcastic comment that only your friend can hear
Stare at them until they move

questions.text: A friend is being picked on. You...

options.text: Step in right away, whatever it costs you
Tell your friend the world doesn't care. They need to get tougher
Get back at the bully, and make sure everyone sees it
Back your friend up with a clever comeback, from a safe distance

questions.text: Your idea of a good Saturday is...

options.text: Classic rock turned up loud, and a workout in the garage
Hanging out with friends who'll hype you up
Working an extra shift, so you've got money to spare
A barbecue at home with the whole family

questions.text: You lose a competition you really wanted to win. You...

options.text: Train twice as hard for the rematch
Congratulate the winner, and mean it
Act like you don't care, then stew about it for weeks
Replay every mistake until you know exactly what went wrong

questions.text: Someone who keeps letting you down finally says sorry. You...

options.text: Don't buy it. You've heard sorry before
Forgive them, but keep your guard up
Give them another chance. People can change
Accept it, then bring it up in every argument from now on

questions.text: You're put in charge of a group project. You...

options.text: Make the plan, and expect everyone to follow it
Run it like a boot camp
Wing it, and somehow pull it off
Offer to do the research, so you don't have to present

questions.text: Someone says you need a fresh start. You...

options.text: Go for new hair, new clothes and a new attitude, all at once
Think about it for months, then change one small thing
Leave your old life behind, and start over somewhere new
Laugh. You're pretty happy as you are

questions.text: Your biggest rival suggests you team up. You...

options.text: Agree, then argue about absolutely everything
Agree, and plan how you'll turn on them later
Only if you're the one in charge
Refuse. You'd rather beat them yourself

questions.text: Your boss asks you to do something shady to get ahead. You...

options.text: Do it, and don't lose sleep over it
Say no, and start wondering what else they're hiding
Say no. You'd rather lose the right way
Do it, if it means your family's taken care of

questions.text: A friend starts dating your ex. You...

options.text: Tell them exactly what you think, to their face
Shut them both out, for good
Wish them well, then rant about it to your best friend
Get jealous, and pretend you're not

questions.text: You run a karate school, and one of your students wins by fighting dirty. You...

options.text: Reward them. Winning is all that matters
Bench them, and teach them some respect
Yell at them, then quietly teach them how to win clean
Make them apologise to the other fighter

questions.text: You're being bullied at school, and a tough karate teacher offers to train you. You...

options.text: Sign up that day, and never get pushed around again
Join, but only so you can protect yourself and others
Look up every dojo in town before deciding anything
Say no. You don't need anyone's help
